selection_criteria.primary_metric: Macro F1-Score (ensures equal penalty across all 22 crop classes)
selection_criteria.secondary_metric: Cross-Validation Mean Accuracy & Low Variance across folds
qualitative_factors: Inherent non-linear feature interaction modeling (decision forest ensemble)
Robustness to non-Gaussian distributions and feature outliers
Direct probabilistic calibration (predict_proba) for confidence estimation
Native feature importance attribution (Mean Decrease in Impurity)
Low inference latency (~13.5 ms/query) well within interactive web budget

disclaimer: SmartAgri-AI provides decision-support predictions based on historical agricultural data. It does not replace professional agronomic advice or local soil testing.
